test_description: Counter overflow — verify uint64_t total sum > 2^32 in NoiseModel::compute_nll_from_histogram and test UINT32_MAX bin increment behavior in avid_dma_ring_consume_slot
input_contract: Total sum > 2^32 must not wrap; individual bin at UINT32_MAX must saturate or report overflow instead of wrapping to 0
independent_oracle: 16 * 0x7FFFFFFF = 34,359,738,352 > 2^32 uniform NLL oracle + UINT32_MAX + 1 saturation check

expected.dma_consume_bin_at_uint32_max: Saturate at UINT32_MAX or return explicit overflow error
expected.noise_model_sum_gt_2pow32: Finite, matches normalized uniform NLL without 32-bit wrap
